title: Pocketwatch
description: Whenever you play [blue]3[/blue] or fewer cards during your turn, draw [blue]3[/blue] additional cards at the start of your next turn.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: The relic tracks cards played each turn during combat. If you play 3 or fewer cards, you gain 3 additional card draw at the start of your next turn. The relic's display status shows as active (highlighted) when the card threshold is currently met.
